CVE-2026-112275.title: Netpbm through 11.16.00 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulne ...
CVE-2026-112275.description: Netpbm through 11.16.00 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the rasttopnm Sun rasterfile run-length decoder pr_load_image in converter/other/rast.c. Attackers can supply a byte-encoded rasterfile with tiny dimensions and a long run-length body to write controlled bytes past md_image, causing memory corruption and crashes.

CVE-2026-112276.title: Netpbm through 11.16.00 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulner ...
CVE-2026-112276.description: Netpbm through 11.16.00 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in rasttopnm that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying Sun rasterfiles with short colormaps. Attackers can craft colormapped rasterfiles with pixel bytes exceeding the palette length to leak up to 255 adjacent heap bytes into the PNM output or crash the program.
